summary: Kerbal Space Program entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Kerbal Space Program
entries.definitive_edition: Kerbal Space Program Complete Edition on PC

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC Complete Edition with documented mod/settings stack

primary.why: The PC Complete Edition route includes the base game plus Making History and Breaking Ground expansions, while PC gives the strongest mod, save, precision-control, and capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Use Kerbal Space Program Complete Edition on PC. Record version, DLC ownership, mods, save/career/science/sandbox mode, control setup, visual mods, and whether console Enhanced Edition is being compared separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record mods and exact version because mod stacks can change the simulation and presentation substantially.
